conventions.fence: fence rows: the kit type and why (type_basis), height and collision half thickness, the stretches cut open along points_m (openings, metres along the line, with what opens them) and the solid runs left (posts on the ground: points_m, terrain_supports, surface_bias_m); a fence row with a prop is built (game/scripts/world/street_fence_kit.gd)
conventions.fenced_approaches: scored-building sides a built fence closes, which the building fit may skip (game/tests/shared/building_fit.gd)
conventions.footprint_m: the plan size {x_m, z_m} of a parked car or a long prop along its local X and Z; with its position and yaw it is the item's rectangle (the gameplay mask checks a stadium that holds it)
conventions.layers: switchable runtime subtrees under PlayableWorld/StreetDetail; ground rows feed the always-on chunk surfaces
conventions.parked_car: a parked car's prop_params: body, paint, finish, roof and rims, and its rest on the visible ground under its four tyres (settleParkedCar in tools/lib/street-clutter-generation.mjs): pitch raises the nose and roll the left side (radians), lift takes the car's origin from y + bias_m to that rest, twist is what the suspension takes up (metres: the front-left and rear-right wheels rise by it in the car frame, the other two drop by it)
conventions.planted: a vegetation row's prop_params: the kit variant and uniform scale, and its rest on the visible ground (settlePlant in tools/lib/street-vegetation-generation.mjs): lift_m takes the foot from y + bias_m to the lowest visible surface round it, foot_spread_m is how much higher the rest of that ground lies (the trunk runs on below the foot); a tree whose foot reaches paving stands in a round mulch pit well_m across on the plane of that paving (well_lift_m its height over the foot at the trunk, well_slope its rise per metre along +X and +Z), which other items keep clear of
conventions.planting_rows: the rows of drifts and fill rules (park beds) in compact blocks, one per rule: the shared id prefix, kind and source id, the props, surfaces, land records and zone sets the rows index, and one array per row in fields order, its number in the block giving its id; readers expand them into the usual rows (unpackPlantingRows in tools/lib/street-planting-generation.mjs, its twin in game/scripts/world/generated_world_contract.gd), and counts count them
conventions.position_m: [x, y, z]; y is the generated land elevation under x, z (terrain_support names the triangle)
conventions.prop: the kit prop the runtime builds for a placed row, with prop_params: the street-furniture kit (game/scripts/world/street_furniture_kit.gd) for the furniture layer, the street-clutter kit (game/scripts/world/street_clutter_kit.gd) for the clutter layer, the street-vegetation kit (game/scripts/world/street_vegetation_kit.gd) for the vegetation layer; rows without one are data only
conventions.prop_feet: per kit prop on legs, the flat bottom of each foot {x, z, half_x, half_z} in the prop's frame (front -Z, right +X) in the kit's leg order: the feet a standing prop settles on, which the kit's legs must stand on
conventions.source_position_m: a stop sign's OSM node position, kept when the sign moves to the curb of its approach
conventions.standing_prop: a furniture set piece on legs (an Adirondack chair) carries its rest on the visible ground under its feet in prop_params (settleOnFeet in tools/lib/street-furniture-generation.mjs): pitch raises its front and roll its left side (radians, together at most 0.15 rad from upright), lift takes its origin from y + bias_m to that rest, and leg_drops_m, where the ground folds under it, lengthens (+) or shortens (-) each leg in the kit's order (front-left, front-right, back-left, back-right; metres, in 5 mm steps)
conventions.status: placed rows are built when their layer is on; excluded rows keep their source id and the reason
conventions.surface: the visible ground surface at x, z (generated feature kind and material, including the raised street ground); set an item on it at y + bias_m
conventions.yaw_radians: rotation about +Y turning the asset's local -Z front; null when the source gives no direction
